title: Stochastic Porous Media Equations With Nonhomogeneous Dirichlet Boundary Conditions
summary: We aim at studying the well-posedness of stochastic porous media equation problems under nonhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary. We obtain an unconventional homogeneous Dirichlet boundary stochastic porous medium equation by transformation under an additional assumption, and then use approximation problems to obtain the well-posedness properties of the equation with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions under different initial conditions. Consequently, we obtain the corresponding solution to the original equation.
